notes: Ollama Auto-Start: the Agent City desktop supervisor now treats Ollama as a companion local service. On launch or tray Restart it probes 127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags; if Ollama is already running it leaves it alone, otherwise it finds ollama.exe via PATH or normal Windows install locations and starts `ollama serve` hidden with output in data/ollama.log. Agent City waits for Ollama readiness when possible before opening. If Ollama cannot be found or started, the city still launches and reports Ollama offline instead of failing the app.
